map.力在时间上的累积等于动量变化。: The accumulation of force over time equals the change in momentum.
map.单位等效动量 kg·m/s。: Units are equivalent to momentum, kg·m/s.
map.缓冲设计：录入减速所需动量变化，求延长作用时间可减小的平均冲击力（如安全气囊）。: Cushioning design: enter the momentum change needed to slow something down and find how much a longer duration reduces the average impact force (as with airbags).
map.碰撞分析：由碰前碰后速度求动量变化，即所受冲量。: Collision analysis: derive the momentum change from the pre- and post-impact velocities — that is the impulse received.
map.教学演示：演示同样动量变化下，时间越长受力越小。: Classroom demo: for the same momentum change, a longer duration means a smaller force.
map.示例：质量 1 kg 物体由 10 m/s 停在 0.1 s 内，Δp=10 k: Example: a 1 kg object brought from 10 m/s to rest in 0.1 s gives Δp=10 kg·m/s and an average force F=Δp/Δt=100 N.
map.冲量和功一样吗？: Is impulse the same as work?
map.不一样：冲量 J=Δp（力×时间）改变动量，功 W=ΔE（力×位移）改变能量。结: No: impulse J=Δp (force × time) changes momentum, while work W=ΔE (force × displacement) changes energy. Results are computed in real time from standard mechanics formulas for physics study, homework and engineering estimates; for safety-critical or real engineering work follow professional standards and measured data.
map.动量变化固定时，延长作用时间 Δt 可大幅降低平均冲击力 F=Δp/Δt。结果按: For a fixed momentum change, extending the duration Δt sharply lowers the average impact force F=Δp/Δt. Results are computed in real time from standard mechanics formulas for physics study, homework and engineering estimates; for safety-critical or real engineering work follow professional standards and measured data.
map.本工具取平均力；变力冲量为力对时间的积分，结果取等效平均。结果按标准力学公式实时: This tool uses the average force; the impulse of a varying force is the integral of force over time, and the result is the equivalent average. Results are computed in real time from standard mechanics formulas for physics study, homework and engineering estimates; for safety-critical or real engineering work follow professional standards and measured data.
